# Serveravatar

ServerAvatar is a server management system that helps you manage servers, applications, databases, and deployments through an intuitive API.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/serveravatar/.

## Actions

- **Get organization details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific organization by ID.
- **List Applications** (read-only): List applications for a specific organization in ServerAvatar.
- **List Backups** (read-only): List all backups in a ServerAvatar organization.
- **List Databases** (read-only): List databases for a given organization.
- **List Organization Members** (read-only): List members of a specific organization in ServerAvatar.
- **List Organizations** (read-only): List all organizations associated with the authenticated user account.
- **List Servers** (read-only): List all servers in an organization with pagination support.
- **Destroy Backups**: Delete one or more backups from the cloud storage provider.
- **List Archived Backups** (read-only): List archived backups for an organization by type.
- **List Backup Presets** (read-only): Retrieve backup preset schedules and retention periods for a server.
- **List Backups for Deleted Servers** (read-only): Get list of deleted servers with available backups.
- **List Cloud Server Providers** (read-only): List connected cloud server provider accounts for an organization.
- **List Cloud Storage Providers** (read-only): List all configured cloud storage providers for an organization.
- **List Cronjobs Presets** (read-only): Retrieve available cronjob presets for a server.
- **List Git Providers** (read-only): List git providers for a specific organization.
- **List Timezones** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available timezones with their UTC offsets.
- **List WordPress Languages** (read-only): Retrieve all available WordPress languages.
